H.E. Mrs Anca Verma, recently appointed Ambassador-at-Large for India of IIMSAM, an intergovernmental organisation holding observer status with the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC), received a warm felicitation by Dr Shyam Raghunandan, Dr Manish, Ms Rashmi and several distinguished well-wishers personally visited Mrs Verma and her husband, Dr Abhishek Verma, Chief National Coordinator, ShivSena, and prominent Indian industrialist and philanthropist, to extend their congratulations and best wishes.

Mrs Verma’s appointment for a five-year term, conferred by H.E. Mr Remigio Maradona, Secretary-General of UN IIMSAM, marks an important milestone in her longstanding commitment to humanitarian service, international cooperation, and social development.

In her new diplomatic role, Mrs Verma will focus on advancing international humanitarian initiatives, particularly combating childhood malnutrition and supporting vulnerable children and communities.
